name: The Re-Write It Project
mission: We provide school supplies to students across Chicagoland. Student-led chapters collect and refurbish donated materials, then work with schools and youth organizations to distribute them.

testimonials.name: MEANS Foundation
testimonials.quote: Your help is greatly appreciated! It has changed many of our students lives. We are so grateful!
testimonials.alt: MEANS volunteers gathered at their 2019 retreat

testimonials.name: The Rohingya Cultural Center
testimonials.quote: Thank you to the Re-Write It Project who helped supply school supplies, books, toys, and more to the RCC! We appreciate all the hard work you are doing!
testimonials.alt: Volunteers at the Rohingya Culture Center of Chicago

testimonials.name: Erie Family Health Foundation
testimonials.quote: Thank you so much for your generous donation of school and art supplies. Your gift will directly benefit young patients who have been greatly impacted by the pandemic. You make our essential work possible!
testimonials.alt: A doctor with a family and three children at Erie Family Health

home_partners.name: Northwestern Medicine Feinberg School of Medicine

timeline.title: A student-led start
timeline.text: Four Chicago high school students founded The Re-Write It Project during the pandemic to address unequal access to essential learning materials.

timeline.title: Community in action
timeline.text: A partnership with Fanari Camp helped create more than 1,700 supply kits, alongside thousands of bulk supplies.

timeline.title: Student chapters
timeline.text: Our student-led chapters have distributed 18,576 school supply kits.
